identity.search_not_issued: No search credential is issued, mounted or referenced (coordinator review of PR 7852). The only candidate roles researcher/persona_session include researcher, which is in services/memory/main.py _MEMORY_WRITE_ROLES (memory checks roles only; the owner-read scope is not enforced), and no existing search read role is write-free (_SEARCH_READ_ROLES: researcher operator admin system analyst; analyst writes Agora notes/signals). The search owner therefore stays unset and the case file records http_401:credential_missing for search_gateway. Consequence: the demand route still opens with a case_file; the evolution executor refuses with its existing case_file_unavailable:evidence:search_gateway:... shape, because evidence is a required group. test_research_case_file_principals_* now fails on any role in any services/*/main.py *_WRITE_ROLES list.
identity.residual_finding: PERSONA_SEARCH_SERVICE_TOKEN (persona_cycle_controller, roles researcher and persona_session) has the same write exposure through memory _MEMORY_WRITE_ROLES. Not changed in this task. A write-free search read role needs a new role in services/search (outside this contract).
identity.research_owner_not_wired: Owners.from_env also has a research owner (PANTHEON_RESEARCH_API_URL). The brief lists memory, telemetry, registry, persona pool and search only, and the only existing research-owner readers are other services' principals, so research-orchestrator-svc leaves it unset. The composer records owner_unconfigured for that source when it needs it; nothing is fabricated.
